purpose: Prospectively correct exactly the two source-grounded v3 harness expectation errors and require a no-service expectation self-test before any live fixture work, without changing the frozen scientific corpus.

supersession.preservation: The v3 manifest, both v3 attempts, raw receipts, cleanup evidence, and adjudication remain immutable. No v3 scenario or repetition is credited to v4.

unchangedBase.bindingV3Amendments: All accepted v3 amendments remain binding except the two expectations explicitly replaced below.

workspacePartitionIdentity.sourceRule: canonical workspace fingerprint = first 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over the canonical absolute normalized workspace path
workspacePartitionIdentity.replaces: v3 runner expectation of the full 64-character workspace SHA-256

projectionAndMongoReferences.eligibleRule: Require exactly one semantic and one episodic Qdrant point at the Java name-UUID of the actual memory ID, each with the actual memory_id, expected agent_id, and a non-empty vector; require Mongo semantic_ref to equal that point ID and Mongo episodic_ref to be absent under the pinned implementation.
projectionAndMongoReferences.ineligibleRule: Require no semantic or episodic Qdrant point and no Mongo semantic_ref or episodic_ref.
projectionAndMongoReferences.replaces: v3 runner expectation that both semantic_ref and episodic_ref are persisted in MongoDB

staticExpectationSelfTest.timing: Before any service query, namespace creation, workspace creation, conversation creation, MongoDB write, Qdrant write, or model call.
inputs: the three pinned SMA source files and their SHA-256 identities
the v3 corrective-rerun raw journal and its SHA-256 identity
the v4 disposable absolute workspace paths
requiredChecks: The pinned intake source contains the 24-character canonical-workspace fingerprint rule.
The pinned replay source performs episodic Qdrant upsert but passes only semanticRef to updateCanonical.
The v4 qualification and measured workspace paths produce their preregistered 24-character fingerprints.
The retained v3 qualification observation passes the corrected agent, point, vector, lifecycle, eligibility, and Mongo-reference expectations.
The retained v3 observation fails the superseded full-hash and Mongo-episodic-ref expectations, proving the self-test discriminates the corrections.
staticExpectationSelfTest.terminal: Any mismatch yields INCONCLUSIVE before live fixture work and does not consume a scenario repetition.

rerunPolicy: No threshold, prompt, memory, expected SMA outcome, or evidence rule may change after v4 is frozen. One corrective v4 rerun is permitted only for a newly documented harness defect that could not have altered an SMA outcome; retain and adjudicate every attempt. Failure of the pre-live static expectation self-test does not authorize live probing.

acceptance.source: Explicit principal instruction in the coordinating Teams session
